Class LRU<K,V>

java.lang.Object
LRU<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the type of keys maintained by this cache
V - the type of mapped values
public class LRU<K,V> extends Object
A generic Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache implementation. Provides O(1) time complexity for both get and put operations.

    • LRU

  • Method Details

    • get

      public V get(K key)
      Retrieves the value associated with the given key if present in the cache. Moves the accessed item to the front of the cache (most recently used position).
      Parameters:
      key - the key whose associated value is to be returned
      Returns:
      the value associated with the key, or null if the key is not present

    • put

      public void put(K key, V value)
      Inserts or updates a key-value pair in the cache. If the key exists, updates its value and moves it to the front. If the key doesn't exist, adds the pair and removes the least recently used item if the cache is at capacity.
      Parameters:
      key - the key with which the specified value is to be associated
      value - the value to be associated with the specified key

    • display

      public void display()
      Displays the current contents of the cache. Prints each key-value pair in the cache.
